name: Viaplay Group AB (publ)
summary: Viaplay Group AB (publ) operates as a multifaceted entertainment and streaming company, serving audiences across the Nordic region, the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, and other international markets. Its primary offering is Viaplay, an online video streaming service that delivers a broad spectrum of content, including live sports, original series and films, documentaries, international TV releases, timeless classic shows, and children's animation. Complementing this, the company also runs Viafree, which offers a selection of complimentary content, and manages the V sport, series & film family of premium television channels. Viaplay Studios, its in-house production arm, is responsible for creating original and animated programming. The group's extensive portfolio of linear TV channels includes commercial powerhouse TV3, the young male-focused TV6, procedural drama channel TV8, and TV10, dedicated to sporting events and documentaries. Further channels like Viasat4 and TV3+ cater to young male demographics, while TV3 PULS features procedural series, cooking, and lifestyle content. Sports enthusiasts are served by TV3 Sport, and TV3 MAX showcases comedy and drama series. Viaplay Group is also a significant presence in radio, operating stations such as Rix FM, Bandit Rock, Power Hit Radio, Star FM, and a range of Norwegian stations including P4 Lyden av Norge, P5 Hits, P6 Rock, P7 Klem, P8 Pop, P9 Retro, and P10 Country. Its digital offerings extend to online platforms like NRJ (an online TV channel), Bandit (an online radio station), and I LIKE RADIO, which provides online music services, news, talk shows, and contests. Furthermore, the company generates revenue by offering advertising services across its television channels, radio stations, and streaming platforms. Founded in 2017 as Nordic Entertainment Group AB (publ), the company rebranded to Viaplay Group AB (publ) in May 2022 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
